description: This file defines a class for performing workflow-related quality checks in an Odoo module, including validation of workflow XML and object configurations.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs workflow validation tests on Odoo modules, checking for proper workflow setup, activity nodes, and XML correctness.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the quality_test class with default parameters such as name, note, minimum score, and installation requirement.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes the workflow validation test, analyzing views, fields, workflows, and activities to compute a score and generate a report.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the overall test result into a table for display.

methods.name: get_result_details
methods.description: Generates detailed HTML report of workflow issues and findings.

methods.name: count_button
methods.description: Recursively counts the number of 'button' elements in an XML node tree.
